items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I feel more at home with people like Wefland and the people around me

ctx.x: Was in that band, and they'd come inbetween shows, maybe -- so I was there -- Wefland said, 'Wait, you said "No." come back, you don't want to (unintelligible), so I went out and had something to eat and I came back was going to meet him. And, so I was in that speakeasy and I was thinking, what am I doing. I'd packed up -- I hadn't played for a couple of months or more. I said this is silly. This is really not what I want to do. I am not interested in school whatsoever. I feel more at home with people like…
He thought the world of you, didn't he?
